title: css-decoupling-lean: a Lean 4 formalization of decoupling translation-invariant topological CSS codes
description: A Lean 4 formalization, using only the standard axioms, of the results of M. He, Y. Wang, H. Song, and Y. Gu, 'Toric codes all the way down: decoupling translation-invariant topological CSS codes in higher dimensions' (2026): the decoupling criterion, the decoupling algorithms and their polynomial cost, minimal coarse-graining, logical qudits on tori, and the glued-code example.

creators.name: He, Mingxin
creators.affiliation: Chen-Ning Yang Institute for Advanced Study, Tsinghua University
